description: Canonical Velsigil client-protocol vectors (SPEC.md section 10). Generated deterministically; do not edit by hand. Ed25519 signatures are deterministic, so server signing code must reproduce envelope.data/sig exactly from payload. Lease `now` values are unix seconds to use as the current time. Envelope vectors with an `hwid` are verified as the answer to a device-bound request sent with that hwid: a lease or activation.hwidHash bound to another hwid is `hwid_mismatch` (SPEC 14). Every envelope vector names the endpoint of its request in `requestType`; a signed payload of another `type` is `type_mismatch`.

encoding.publicKey: standard base64 (padded) of raw 32-byte Ed25519 public key
encoding.data: base64url without padding of UTF-8 JSON
encoding.sig: base64url without padding; signature over the ASCII bytes of the data string
